wwe counter arcade.name: WWE Counter Arcade
wwe counter arcade.description: Step into the ring and relive the golden era of arcade gaming with the Arcade Classics Counter Series WWE Arcade Game—an electrifying mini cabinet packed with four legendary titles that bring the heat of the arcade right to your countertop! Whether you're delivering bone-crushing body slams in WrestleFest, entering the squared circle in SuperStars, dominating the mat in The Big Pro Wrestling!, or dodging chaos in Super Dodgeball, every moment explodes with fast-paced, retro-style action.Designed with true fans in mind, this compact unit delivers authentic gameplay that stays true to the originals. The oversized 8" liquid crystal screen displays each pixel in full-color clarity, making every slam and dodge look just like it did back in the day. With crisp, vibrant visuals and pixel-perfect graphics, you’ll feel like you’ve been transported straight into a classic arcade.The cabinet features a real arcade-style joystick and action-ready buttons that give you the tactile feedback and precision control needed to slam, grapple, and dodge your way to victory. Combined with faithfully reproduced soundtracks and effects, every game bursts with nostalgic energy and excitement. From the roar of the crowd to the sound of a perfect hit, this machine captures the spirit of the arcade in every match.No batteries are needed—just plug in and play, thanks to the included AC adapter. Whether you're a die-hard WWE superfan, a retro gaming enthusiast, or shopping for the perfect throwback gift, this arcade game delivers big-time fun in a compact, stylish package. Recommended for ages 8 and up, it's the ultimate countertop champion for any game room or collector’s display.
